name: media-pipeline
description: Generate AI images locally through a bundled MCP server and standalone CLI, powered by Google Gemini, OpenAI, or Atlas Cloud.
long_description: A production-oriented MCP Bundle for local image generation workflows with provider support for Google Gemini, OpenAI, and Atlas Cloud. The bundle exposes a create_asset MCP tool, validates requests defensively, uses bundled Node entry points for both the MCP server and the standalone CLI, and saves generated images directly to local disk for easy use in websites, documents, and presentations.

GEMINI_API_KEY.title: Gemini API Key
GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Your Google Gemini API key. Get one at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. At least one provider API key must be provided.

GEMINI_DEFAULT_MODEL.title: Default Model
GEMINI_DEFAULT_MODEL.description: Preferred model for image generation. Available models are fetched dynamically from the Gemini API at runtime.

OPENAI_API_KEY.title: OpenAI API Key
OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Your OpenAI API key. Get one at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys. At least one provider API key must be provided.

OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL.title: Default OpenAI Model
OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL.description: Preferred OpenAI model for image generation.

ATLASCLOUD_API_KEY.title: Atlas Cloud API Key
ATLASCLOUD_API_KEY.description: Your Atlas Cloud API key. Get one at https://www.atlascloud.ai. At least one provider API key must be provided.

IMAGE_PROVIDER.title: Default Provider
IMAGE_PROVIDER.description: Which provider (gemini, openai, or atlas) to use when a request omits a model. Explicit gpt-image*/dall-e* names route to OpenAI and provider/model names route to Atlas Cloud.

IMAGE_OUTPUT_DIR.title: Output Directory
IMAGE_OUTPUT_DIR.description: Directory where generated images will be saved. Leave blank to use a generated-images folder in your home directory.

GEMINI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS.title: Request Timeout (ms)
GEMINI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Maximum time to wait for image generation requests (applies to every provider)

MEDIA_PIPELINE_LOG_LEVEL.title: Log Level
MEDIA_PIPELINE_LOG_LEVEL.description: Logging level written to stderr for diagnostics

tools.name: create_asset
tools.description: Generate an image with Google Gemini, OpenAI, or Atlas Cloud, save it locally, and return the output path plus structured metadata.
